mechanism: Ethambutol may impair renal function and increase risk of diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA) when combined with SGLT2 inhibitors; dapagliflozin increases urinary glucose excretion and risk of genitourinary infections.
action: Monitor renal function and blood glucose closely; counsel on DKA symptoms and genitourinary infection signs; consider alternative TB therapy if renal impairment develops.
